title: Distributivity transported action (left)
statement: Let U and V be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f : U → V, and O a commutative ring sheaf on the small etale site of V [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let L be the set inverse image, assumed to preserve finite limits, La the fixed abelian inverse image, and Lr any left adjoint to the sectionwise ring direct image. Write FrU, FrV and FaU, FaV for the respective underlying-set functors. Assume natural isomorphisms er : Lr ⋙ FrU ≅ FrV ⋙ L and ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L, and assume that both ring and abelian adjunction hom equivalences commute with the set adjunction through er and ea, as in [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. For any O-module sheaf G [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], write FV(G) for its abelian sheaf, A = La(FV(G)), and OR for the ring sheaf underlying Lr(O). Let muV : FrV(O) × FaV(FV(G)) → FaV(FV(G)) be any sheaf morphism whose section values are the scalar action of G applied to its two product projections. Define mu by prod.map(er.hom(O),ea.hom(FV(G))), then the inverse product comparison for L, then L(muV), then ea.inv(FV(G)). Let e be the canonical isomorphism from the categorical product FrU(Lr(O)) × FaU(A) to the chosen sectionwise product of these sheaves, determined by the product projections. Set act_W(r,x) = (e.inv ≫ mu)_W(r,x). For every object W of the small etale site of U, r in OR(W), and x,y in A(W), act_W(r,x+y) = act_W(r,x)+act_W(r,y). No scalar-additivity, multiplicative, or unit law is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain source and target addition morphisms, their section formulas and their transport equation directly for the supplied ea, using etaleInverseImageAbelianLift_operations and the abelian half of the hom-equivalence hypothesis. No ring addition comparison is needed.

Prove the source distributivity diagram by extensionality on sheaf morphisms and sections; the formula for muV, the formulas for addition, the product projection identities, and smul_add give the equality.
Apply productComparison_distributivity to the source diagram and addition transport equation, with er.app O and ea.app FV(G).

Use the canonical categorical-product to section-product isomorphism and its two projection identities. Form the triple section (r,(x,y)), show its addition projection is (r,x+y) and its selection projections are (r,x) and (r,y), then evaluate the transported diagram.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleInverseImageScalarDistributivity_left (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V)
    (O : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f)] :
    let L := Scheme.etaleSetPullback f
    let La := Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let a := Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let FaU := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FaV := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let FrU := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FrV := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f
    let aS := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous b
      (Type (u + 1)) (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    let Rr := b.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u + 1}
      (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    ∀ (Lr : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1} ⥤
        Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
      (ar : Lr ⊣ Rr) (er : Lr ⋙ FrU ≅ FrV ⋙ L),
    let OR := (sheafCompose U.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (Lr.obj O)
    let OV := (sheafCompose V.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj O
    let FV := SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} OV
    ∀ (ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L),
      (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (h : Lr.obj G ⟶ F),
        FrV.map (ar.homEquiv G F h) =
          aS.homEquiv (FrV.obj G) (FrU.obj F) (er.inv.app G ≫ FrU.map h)) ∧
      (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (h : La.obj G ⟶ F),
        FaV.map (a.homEquiv G F h) =
          aS.homEquiv (FaV.obj G) (FaU.obj F) (ea.inv.app G ≫ FaU.map h)) →
    ∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} OV,
    ∀ muV : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)),
      (∀ (W : V.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : ((FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G))).obj.obj W),
        muV.hom.app W x =
          @SMul.smul (O.obj.obj W) (G.val.obj W) (G.val.obj W).isModule.toSMul
            ((prod.fst : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶
              FrV.obj O).hom.app W x : O.obj.obj W)
            ((prod.snd : (FrV.obj O) ⨯ (FaV.obj (FV.obj G)) ⟶
              FaV.obj (FV.obj G)).hom.app W x : G.val.obj W)) →
    let A := La.obj (FV.obj G)
    let mu := prod.map (er.hom.app O) (ea.hom.app (FV.obj G)) ≫
      inv (prodComparison L (FrV.obj O) (FaV.obj (FV.obj G))) ≫
      L.map muV ≫ ea.inv.app (FV.obj G)
    let e : (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj A) ≅
        (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⊗ (FaU.obj A) :=
      (limit.isLimit _).conePointUniqueUpToIso
        (CartesianMonoidalCategory.tensorProductIsBinaryProduct _ _)
    let act : ∀ W : U.Etaleᵒᵖ, OR.obj.obj W → A.obj.obj W → A.obj.obj W :=
      fun W r x ↦ (e.inv ≫ mu).hom.app W (r, x)
    ∀ W : U.Etaleᵒᵖ,
      (∀ (r : OR.obj.obj W) (x y : A.obj.obj W),
        act W r (x + y) = act W r x + act W r y )
